scope: Final audit of Batch 1.5 against its specifications: refuse a client-supplied browser write grant, make the guest rate-limit key unspoofable on Google Cloud, give Cloud Run workers unique ids, stop caching transient Drive failures, schedule Drive reconciliation behind a signed internal route, and make the startup policy Cloud Run aware (still deliberately not wired; the cutover patch is saved). Nothing is applied, deployed or enabled.

keep: The deliberate decision not to wire startup policy and readiness before the Google cutover (bootGuard.test.ts)
Existing Drive, lease and browser-worker architecture
extend: A signed internal storage reconcile route using the existing Cloud Scheduler ID-token verifier

auth.description: The scheduled reconcile route requires a Google-signed ID token for one named service account and audience and is off by default. The browser-runs route refuses a client-supplied write grant.

tenant.description: No tenant boundary changes; the reconcile response carries counts only.

approval.description: Consequential browser steps can only be authorised by a grant the server issues; a request can no longer carry one.

cost.description: No cost changes. The reconcile call is bounded to 200 rows and never scans the bucket.

tests.scope: Forged write grant refused, guest address not spoofable, scheduled reconcile authentication and bounds, Cloud Run environment classification.

architecture.reason: Extends existing routes, the existing scheduler authentication and the existing startup policy. No new service, scheduler or runtime.

rollout: Merge only after review and your authorization, as part of the coordinated Batch 1.5 activation. Set the XROGA_STORAGE_RECONCILE_* variables and create the Cloud Scheduler job only as a separate approved step.
rollback: Leave XROGA_STORAGE_RECONCILE_MODE unset (the default); revert the change to remove the code.
knownGaps: Browser runs execute in the request process: cross-instance cancel, stall under request-based CPU and unwired lease recovery need a Google architecture decision
Startup policy and readiness wiring is saved as a patch for the cutover release
Nothing was verified on a live Cloud Run service or hosted database
placeholderClaimsRemaining: Live Google Cloud behaviour of Batch 1.5 is unverified

blockers: Google Cloud migration (Codex) not complete and verified
